resume_brief: STANDALONE BRIEF — owner-directed 2026-10-09: he generates 'statue' models with Tripo AI and does not know what they need to become working game characters. Build the FULL pipeline in the Bannon repo so it's all there, documented, and wired up — no guessing. CONTEXT: we have Blender 4.0.2 headless, the weight-paint PWA (tools/weight-paint-pwa/), probe scripts (tools/rig-repair/probe_shoulders.py), and research (docs/AI_RIGGING_RESEARCH.md) covering Mixamo auto-rigger, retargeting, corrective shape keys. YOUR JOB: build tools/statue-to-game/ containing: (1) PIPELINE.md — the complete checklist of what a Tripo statue needs: mesh cleanup (scale, pose, watertight check), auto-rigging (document the Mixamo auto-rigger path step-by-step + the free AccuRIG alternative, with exactly what to upload and what comes back), skinning (auto-weights + when to use the paint PWA), animation (retarget path from the research), GLB export settings for three.js, and the verification gates (probe renders at 15-90deg, rotation error, feet-on-ground). Each step: what it is in plain language, how to do it, how to know it worked. (2) Scripts where automatable: a mesh-intake checker (loads a Tripo GLB/OBJ, reports scale, vertex count, is-it-posed, watertight issues), and a single verify_character.py that runs the full gate suite on a finished GLB and gives a PASS/FAIL report card. (3) Wire the weight-paint PWA into the pipeline doc as the 'fix weights' step. RULES: heartbeat THIS checkpoint every 15 min; everything must actually run (test the intake checker + verifier on STICKUP_repaired.glb); plain language — the owner is not a rigger; branch -> PR, never direct to main. Report: the PR link + test results on the real model.
